title: Experiment-off rollback equivalence
purpose: Verify that disabling a reversible lab experiment returns the observable regtest path to the previously recorded baseline without defining new authorization semantics.
assumptions: Bitcoin Core behavior outside the isolated experiment path remains unchanged.
The scenario runs only on local regtest and does not launch a public network.
No post-quantum scheme or hybrid authorization rule is selected by this scenario.

steps.action: Record the experiment-off regtest evidence set before any reversible lab activity.
Prepare isolated reversible lab state without changing upstream behavior outside the experiment path.
Disable the isolated experiment and restore the pre-experiment lab state.

decision_gates: Any post-quantum signature scheme selection requires explicit user review.
Any hybrid authorization or Bitcoin consensus semantics require explicit user review.
Any activation, fork deployment, legacy or lost UTXO treatment requires explicit user review.
Any recovery authority, trust-root, key-custody, or production security semantics require explicit user review.
